test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Identify the number that is different from the rest.

23, 29, 31, 37, 42, 43, 47
solution:
The logic is here,

In given series 23, 29, 31, 37, 43, 47 all are prime number except 42.

41 is prime number not 42.

Hence, **“42”** is correct answer.
